flow: ui-path (ChatDriver) — composer insertText + Enter, streamed answer

steps.note: session snapshot injected (data/www.kimi.com/.session); .cn mirror kimi.moonshot.cn is the same site surface on a different login host
jittered 600-1300ms human dwell; sidebar '新建对话' button (route /chat/new is the fresh conversation)
trusted keyboard.insertText into composer candidate (see profile composer; none verified yet)
answer selector UNVERIFIED — see profile selectorNotes for candidates to confirm on first live capture

rpc: Chat is server-streamed via kimi.gateway.chat.v1.ChatService.Chat over Connect: POST https://notilo.kimi.com/apiv2/kimi.gateway.chat.v1/ChatService/Chat, body = ChatRequest (chat_id, scenario, tools, message, options{thinking, reasoning_effort, context_length, model}), response = stream of ChatResponse sliced client-side into kimi.chat.v1.Block/TextBlock segments (kimi.chatMessages-*.js); dropped chunks resume via ResumeChat, continue via ContinueChat. UI path below drives the SPA; a later incarnation of this package may call ChatService.Chat directly via page fetch + protobuf once the frame layout is captured. No RPC payloads verified on the wire yet.
stealth: real session (localStorage access_token), trusted inputs, site's own send handler — indistinguishable from the user typing; avoids TrustDecision/captcha gates
